content: Customer Pooja Bhatia called to confirm the cancellation of her auto insurance policy (AUTO-4598) because she is planning to sell her car. The agent, Karan Joshi, verified the details, waived the $45 cancellation fee due to her good claim history with no claims in the past three years, and arranged a prorated refund of $80 via direct deposit. The cancellation was successfully processed with an effective date of 30/09/2026, and a confirmation email was sent.

action_items: Send a confirmation email for the policy cancellation
Issue a direct deposit refund of $80 to the bank account on file
